summary: The filing is a foreign private issuer's Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting held on June 25, 2026. It discloses votes on director emoluments, auditor reappointment, adoption of financial statements, director re-election, and a share issuance mandate. There is no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign. The filing is a routine shareholder meeting update with no material corporate action beyond ordinary governance items.
